contract: pinned Amplify Gen 2 repeat, watch/edit, native hotswap plus fallback, unsupported-edit retention, named delete/recreate, and two-identifier isolation

repeatInventory.classification: The pinned CLI performs a harmless CloudFormation reconciliation because the generated API-key expiry is time-relative.
invariants: all root/nested stack IDs and logical-to-physical resource mappings remain unchanged
one AppSync API, one Todo table, and four generated/helper Lambda functions remain
the generated output bytes and redacted digest remain unchanged
the managed bootstrap descriptor and all shared asset version counts remain unchanged
no duplicate API, API key, table, function, subscription configuration, stack, or shared asset version is created

Lambda: Invoke on the two CloudFormation-owned Custom::CDKBucketDeployment provider functions

fallbackObserved: CloudFormation UpdateStack after the scalar edit
CloudFormation UpdateStack for the API-key expiry edit
serviceActionInventory.classificationRule: Only the standard cdk-hotswap/success-<service> user agent enters drift accounting; ordinary direct SDK calls retain their existing semantics.

resourceEditDiffInventory.direct: two successful Lambda Invoke calls update the model-introspection and generated-code bucket deployments
resourceEditDiffInventory.fallback: ordinary recursive CloudFormation UpdateStack reconciles the schema and generated graph
preserved: last stabilized output until CLI rewrite

resourceEditDiffInventory.fallback: ordinary CloudFormation UpdateStack updates the generated API-key expiration

resourceEditDiffInventory.result: synthesis rejects with TypeError before workload mutation; prior backend and output remain usable

ownershipAndDrift.index: account/Region reverse keys for physical ID, ARN, Lambda function, and AppSync schema/function/resolver/API-key identity map to stack ID, logical ID, root ID, and completed deployment generation
ownershipAndDrift.admission: unmanaged, ambiguous, or stale ownership rejects before direct mutation
ownershipAndDrift.cloudFormationIsolation: direct success mutates service state only; it does not mutate stored templates, events, stack status, outputs, or completed resource generations
ownershipAndDrift.convergence: the subsequent completed root deployment publishes a new generation, rebuilds ownership, and clears current drift while retaining bounded operation history

fallbackAndFailureInventory: pre-call unsupported synthesis: no direct call and no CloudFormation fallback
pre-call unmanaged/ambiguous/stale target: deterministic 409 rejection for pinned CDK fallback handling
before-direct-call injected fault: FAILED operation with unchanged service revision
after-direct-call injected fault: new service revision remains recorded as INTENTIONAL partial runtime drift
ordinary fallback after successful direct calls: direct operation history remains and completed CloudFormation generation clears current drift
failed AppSync schema stabilization: pending operation becomes FAILED on GetSchemaCreationStatus

deleteRecreateInventory.selector: --identifier is mandatory in the frozen command; no default or sibling selection is inferred
deleteRecreateInventory.deleteOrder: recursive provider dependencies delete generated custom resources before their helper functions/roles and remove nested stacks before the root completes
preserved: amx10b stack and all of its workload
deleteRecreateInventory.sameIdentifierRecreation: amx10a recreates with a new root stack ID, immediately reuses its exact SSM names after owned deletion, writes a new stabilized output, and passes the complete Amplify client workflow

limits: The frozen scalar/API-key source corpus emitted no direct AppSync hotswap call; AppSync direct support is regression-tested at the ordinary service endpoints and must not be claimed as observed CLI behavior for these two edits.
The pinned Windows watcher emits two file events for one atomic source write and queues a second deployment; evidence records both instead of deduplicating or bypassing CLI watch behavior.
